statement: Bain estimates the global AI industry must generate $6 trillion in annual revenue by 2031 to justify committed data-center capital, with existing consumer and enterprise AI services covering up to $1.8 trillion and leaving a $4.2 trillion revenue shortfall.
why: The size of the gap between required and identified AI revenue is the central risk to the durability of accelerator demand: if the nascent categories do not arrive, buildout plans get cut.

impact.mechanism: Unmonetized capacity eventually forces buyers to slow orders, so a revenue shortfall of this scale is a forward brake on accelerator and data-center demand.

evidence.excerpt: Bain & Co. says the global AI industry will need to generate '$6 trillion' in annual revenue by 2031 to justify the scale of capital being deployed on data-center construction worldwide.

confidence.basis: Third-party forecast relayed by a single secondary outlet; a projection, not a realized figure.

entity: multi (data-center / AI infrastructure industry); Bain & Co (forecaster)
